description: Use this when someone asks about the Galápagos in a given month or the best time to visit: air and sea temperature, typical rain, sea state and ferry seasickness level, crowds, wetsuit advice, and what the wildlife is doing that month (albatross, booby courtship, turtle nesting, whale and hammerhead season and more). Examples: "What is the Galápagos like in August?" / "¿Cómo está el clima en Galápagos en agosto?"

month.description: Month as 1–12 or an English month name. Default: the current month in the Galápagos.

name: month_guide

link.description: Page on galapagosislands.info with these inputs filled in.

title: Galápagos month by month
